resolved.Name: S3b
resolved.Title: graceful restart
resolved.Description: Graceful stop at 60s (SIGTERM on Linux; POST /v1/admin/shutdown on Windows, which has no SIGTERM), restart at 70s. A graceful stop finishes in-flight batches, parks the rest and writes a final checkpoint, so nothing is replayed: dup must be 0 on every sink (assuming no request times out ambiguously during the stop).

notes: kill = SIGKILL; graceful stop = SIGTERM. kill -9 is not power loss (page cache survives).
